name: agent-diff-tracker
description: Automatically shows a diff view of the most recently changed file in your workspace, so you can watch what your AI agent is doing in real time.

commands.title: Agent Diff Tracker: Show Latest Changed File Diff

agentDiffTracker.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after a file change before opening its diff (avoids flicker during rapid multi-file writes).

agentDiffTracker.exclude.description: Glob patterns to ignore when watching for changes.

agentDiffTracker.preserveFocus.description: When true, the diff tab opens without stealing editor focus from where you're typing.
